messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hello honey, it's Gloria Hart. I need the water pill...
AGENT: Hi Gloria! I'd be happy to help you with your water pill. Let me pull up your information first—can you give me your date of birth?
CALLER: Oh, wait, honey, no, not the water pill - I meant the blood pressure one... lisinopril, that's the one.
AGENT: Got it, lisinopril for blood pressure. I still need your date of birth to look up your prescription—can you give me that?
CALLER: Oh yes, sorry honey. It's May 12th, 1947.
AGENT: Thank you, Gloria. Let me pull up your prescriptions. Great, Gloria. Now let me find your lisinopril prescription. I found your lisinopril 10 mg, Gloria, but it has zero refills left. I can send a renewal request to Dr. Raj Patel—would you like me to do that?  [system actions: verify_identity, list_prescriptions]
CALLER: No refills? What do I do, honey?
AGENT: I can request a renewal from Dr. Patel right now, and he should get back to us. In the meantime, if you're running low and worried you might run out before he responds, a pharmacist here can look at whether we can give you a short emergency supply under state rules—but I can't promise that. Would you like me to go ahead and request the renewal?
CALLER: Oh, yes please, honey, go ahead and ask the doctor. I've only got about a week's worth left, so I hope he answers quick.
AGENT: Perfect, Gloria. I've sent the renewal request to Dr. Patel. Since you're getting low on time, let me also flag our pharmacist to give you a call about whether an emergency supply might be possible while we wait for the doctor to respond.  [system actions: request_renewal]
CALLER: Oh, thank you, honey, that would be a relief. How long do you think it'll take to hear back?
AGENT (LATEST): I wish I could say for sure, Gloria, but it depends on how quickly Dr. Patel's office processes it—could be a day or two, or sometimes longer. Our pharmacist will be calling you soon to talk about the emergency supply option, so that should help bridge the gap while we wait.

CONDITIONS:
stop_0: Agent confirms a renewal request to Dr. Patel with a timeline.
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirmed renewal request sent, gave rough timeline of a day or two."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency services."}}
